notes: IMDuel on Ethereum (chain 1): chess played by trades. The engine (0xc21788f704a8b9456f7391a01d8a3d95be215a27) is replaced by the ChessEngineV5 address from the engine launch (launch/engine.json) before this launch is opened. Constructor arguments in declaration order: manager = $poolManager; engine = ChessEngineV5 (its code is not checked in the constructor, so the hook builds where the engine has none; the address is checked off chain); imd = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7; minImd 10 IMD and minImduel 1,000,000 IMDUEL: the smallest pile worth one conversion batch; turnBlocks 3: how many blocks a move takes bids for (about 36 seconds). No owner, admin, pause, upgrade path or backend signer. The token is src/IMDuelToken.sol on the standard terms (1,000,000,000 fixed, 18 decimals, the whole supply minted to the factory, plain transfers, no owner, mint, burn, tax, pause or blocklist). The factory deploys the hook and the token and opens this pool (IMD pair, fee 12500, spacing 60) in one transaction; the first pool opened on the hook is the main duel and must pair IMD (afterInitialize reverts otherwise), its other currency becomes $IMDUEL; every later duel must pair IMD or $IMDUEL (NoRoute otherwise; there is no native ETH route) and never pays the opening surcharge. Fee: 0.5% of every swap of its pools through beforeSwapReturnDelta / afterSwapReturnDelta, on top of the untouched 1.25% LP fee: 0.4% to the pool's war chest (reward pool) worth less at the pool price, 0.1% protocol slice converted into $IMDUEL, half to the main duel's $IMDUEL chest and half burned to 0x...dEaD; for the main duel's first 300 seconds the chest share starts 25% higher and falls linearly to 0.4%, all of it to the chest (time only, nothing per wallet). A swap must trade its whole order: one its price limit stops early reverts (PartialFill). Liquidity callbacks are not used. Conversion batches (convert / convertBatch, anyone may call) spend at most 10 minimums, run at most once per block and buy within 0.1% of the most hook-favourable sqrt price the main duel had at the start of its three latest sampled blocks (sampled before every trade and batch of it; nothing is bought until three blocks are sampled). Play: every buy bids for its team's next move; its owner is the address in hookData (20 bytes packed or 32 bytes ABI-encoded), else the wallet that signed the transaction, so a trade through any router earns (a trade relayed for a smart-contract wallet without hookData credits the relayer: known, accepted); the biggest owns it and a new top bid must pay more than 10% over the current one; a move takes bids for 3 blocks after the previous one was played, and the first swap after its window plays it through a gas-capped external call to the engine, seeded by the hash of the window's last block (BLOCKHASH, or the EIP-2935 history contract beyond 256 blocks; a hash no longer served gives a 0% timeout turn). An engine failure never reverts a swap; an engine starved by the swap's own gas limit reverts it (NotEnoughGas). A move's reward is recorded from its team's chest for its owner to claim (withdraw(who, c): anyone may call it, it only pays who; withdrawTo(c, to): the owed party, to an address it names); nothing is ever sent inside a trade, so no recipient runs code while a trader's PoolManager is unlocked.
